question: do the campaign's validation verdicts survive the corrected reference generator, which disables ONNX Runtime's graph optimisation so every system executes the graph as written?
method: each model's reference was regenerated with the corrected generator and its existing base artifact re-run against it at the study's 1e-4 tolerance; no timing was repeated, since timing does not depend on the reference beyond the admission check
note: the largest of these is 1.72e-5, four orders below the tolerance. Time was not re-measured, so the recorded timings stand; what changed is the reference every verdict is measured against, and every verdict holds. The campaign-wide maximum the manuscript cites also covers the other systems' rows, which are not re-checked here.
